question: The owner approved DEC-001 (partner-first entry through a module inside an existing channel partner's offering, followed by licensing, retaining OD-M-05 as a possible long-term destination). CNV-ECO-004, ratified by OD-M-05, names mid-size national and single-issue sponsors and advisor-distributed sponsors as the initial target segment. Should CNV-ECO-004 be amended through the ratification process to make partner-first entry the initial commercial route, with the OD-M-05 segment retained as the long-term destination, once V-1 and V-6 report?
recommendation: Keep CNV-ECO-004 unchanged until V-1 and V-6 report; then prepare a ratification packet amending its entry-route wording, keeping the segment as destination. Until then partner-embedded and partner-operated modes are architectural support only.
alternatives: Amend CNV-ECO-004 now on the strength of DEC-001; keep CNV-ECO-004 and treat DEC-001 as commercial practice outside the clause.
rationale: A ratified clause cannot be silently amended; DEC-001 is conditioned on V-1 and V-6, which have not run.
governing_text_now: CNV-ECO-004 as amended 2026-11-27 (OD-M-17; original text preserved in its revision history)
owner_resolution: Partner-first entry with V-1/V-6 retained; OD-M-05 segment kept as long-term destination (amends CNV-ECO-004)

question: Within the preserved 180-day validity (CNV-GRT-003 'deep review SHALL default to 180 days ... with refresh 30 days before expiry'; RR-REQ-X-007-r1 'a comprehensive charity review MUST occur at the deep-review interval'), may the deep review be satisfied by a change-driven renewal that finds monitoring continuous for every monitorable predicate, no eligibility-relevant change, and every non-monitorable evidence item unexpired (refreshing only expired or changed items), as RR-REQ-X-007-r2 item 1 proposes and DEC-003 approves in direction?
recommendation: Accept the reading after V-3 (replay change rate and auto-resolution) and V-9 (auditor walkthrough) report, keeping the 180-day ceiling, event-triggered invalidation and release-time checks unchanged; until then perform the deep review as RR-REQ-X-007-r1 specifies.
alternatives: Require full repetition at every interval (status quo reading); amend CNV-GRT-003 to remove the interval (not approved: DEC-003 preserves it).
rationale: DEC-003 preserves the 180-day validity and requires V-3 and V-9; the ratified wording does not say whether a renewal may rely on unchanged monitored evidence.
governing_text_now: CNV-GRT-003 as amended 2026-11-27 (OD-M-18; original text preserved in its revision history)
owner_resolution: Change-driven renewal within the 180-day ceiling, with evidence freshness and targeted review (amends CNV-GRT-003); who performs the deep review stays open as OD-CDD-06

question: The owner approved DEC-006 (licensing or subscription before asset-based administration fees for initial offerings, preserving V-2). Open decision OD-CNO-10 and the recorded agent-recommended answer to FIL-OD-10 reason from a ~20 bps servicing fee. Should those working assumptions be restated on a licence-first basis, with bps retained only for a later administration offer?
recommendation: Yes: restate OD-CNO-10 and FIL-OD-10 on a licence or subscription basis when they are next resolved; keep bps only as a labelled working assumption for a later administration offer; leave both records unedited until then.
alternatives: Leave the 20 bps assumptions as they are; replace them now by editing the records (would overwrite history).
rationale: Avoids two contradictory pricing bases in Unbound records while preserving the historical records.
governing_text_now: OD-M-19 with OD-M-11; OD-CNO-10 open; FIL-OD-10 as recorded
owner_resolution: Model licensing and 20 bps independently; OD-CNO-10 and FIL-OD-10 not edited

question: The owner approved DEC-002 (no custodial administrator as the initial commercial vehicle; the signed $0.5-1.0B anchor and other gates before reconsidering full-service administration; the threshold is a planning assumption). OD-M-08 plans an Unbound-operated (non-custodial, CNV-LEG-001) administration team as a second offer, and CNV-GOV-001 starts SOC 1 Type 2 readiness before the first staffed-administration client. Does the DEC-002 anchor gate also apply to the OD-M-08 staffed-administration offer?
recommendation: Yes: treat the OD-M-08 staffed-administration offer as gated behind the same anchor evidence; keep it architecturally supported (CNV-ECO-004) and keep the CNV-GOV-001 SOC 1 timing rule unchanged.
alternatives: Gate only custodial forms; leave OD-M-08 timing unconstrained.
rationale: DEC-002 speaks of custodial or full-service administration while OD-M-08's offer is non-custodial; the overlap needs an owner reading rather than an agent inference.
governing_text_now: CNV-ECO-004 as amended 2026-11-27 (OD-M-20; original text preserved in its revision history)
owner_resolution: Anchor gate applies to full-service administration, not limited support (amends CNV-ECO-004; OD-M-08 not edited)

question: Under partner-first entry (DEC-001), revenue may arrive through one channel partner covering several sponsors. Does the CNV-ECO-004 concentration rule (no sponsor above 25% of annual recurring revenue after year 3 without a board-approved exception) apply per end sponsor or per channel partner, and what transition policy applies before year 3?
recommendation: Measure concentration both per end sponsor and per channel partner; disclose both for years 1-3 as CNV-ECO-004 requires; require the concentration exception record for either measure after year 3.
alternatives: Per end sponsor only; per partner only.
rationale: The research notes every single-customer start breaches the cap without a transition policy; a partner channel concentrates revenue in a way the clause does not name.
governing_text_now: CNV-ECO-004 as amended 2026-11-27 (OD-M-17; original text preserved in its revision history)
owner_resolution: Measure concentration at both end-sponsor and partner levels (amends CNV-ECO-004)

question: Under the OD-CDD-02 resolution (change-driven renewal within the 180-day ceiling), who performs the CNV-GRT-003 deep review and any targeted review: the platform's registry steward, each sponsor's own compliance staff, or a delegated partner under a ServiceDelegation (Phase III P3-DEC-MOD005)?
recommendation: Keep the decision with each sponsor (sponsor-reserved eligibility decisions, CNV-GRT-004); allow a delegated partner or registry steward to prepare the review under a ServiceDelegation, never to decide it.
alternatives: Platform registry steward performs it for all sponsors; sponsor-only with no delegation.
rationale: OD-CDD-02 decided how the deep review may be satisfied but not who performs it; the owner noted this remains open in Phase III.
